channel.title: BusinessHub.cy — Compliance
channel.description: Latest Compliance stories from BusinessHub.cy, Cyprus Edition.

item.title: CC_31/2026 - Extensive listing of persons on the EU restrictive measures list against Russia
item.description: ICPAC has issued Compliance Circular 31/2026 notifying members of a major expansion to the EU restrictive measures list targeting individuals and entities related to the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

item.title: Sanctions alert 10/2026
item.description: ICPAC has issued Sanctions Alert 10/2026, providing updated compliance directives for certified public accountants in Cyprus.

item.title: CC 32_26 - NSIU announcement -Revised templates & Communication channels
item.description: ICPAC has issued updated templates and communication protocols for reporting to the National Sanctions Implementation Unit (NSIU) to ensure compliance with financial sanctions.

item.title: CC 33/2026 - Update of EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions for taxation
item.description: ICPAC has issued Compliance Circular 33/2026 to notify members of the latest updates to the EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions for tax purposes.

item.title: TC 3/2019 (Revised) Illustrative Limited Assurance Report on the Safeguarding of Client Assets by Ba
item.description: ICPAC has released a revised illustrative limited assurance report for banking institutions to comply with Central Bank of Cyprus requirements regarding client asset safeguarding.

item.title: TC 08/2026: Illustrative statutory audit engagement letters
item.description: ICPAC has issued updated technical circular TC 08/2026 providing illustrative engagement letters for statutory audits to ensure alignment with current auditing standards and Cyprus law.

item.title: General Circular 10/2026: Call for Interest for the Institute's Committees for the two-year period 2027-2028
item.description: ICPAC invites members to apply for its professional committees for the 2027-2028 term under a newly revised operating framework.

item.title: Technical Alert - October 2026 Edition
item.description: ICPAC has issued the Technical Alert for October 2026, providing updated professional and regulatory guidance for certified public accountants in Cyprus.

item.title: CC 34/2026 - Update of the FATF list
item.description: ICPAC has issued Compliance Circular 34/2026 to notify members of the latest updates to the FATF lists of high-risk and monitored jurisdictions.

item.title: REMINDER - Registration for AML/CFT Certification exam for 12 January 2027
item.description: ICPAC reminds firms of the upcoming AML/CFT Certification exam on January 12, 2027, mandatory for new Compliance Officer appointments to maintain valid practicing certificates.

item.title: Questions and answers on the agreement on the EU Annual Budget 2027
item.description: The EU's 2027 budget reaches €211.5 billion, focusing on full-speed program implementation and economic security while transitioning toward the 2028-2034 long-term financial framework.

item.title: Speech by President von der Leyen at the United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31)
item.description: EU President von der Leyen reaffirms aggressive 2040 emission targets and a global electrification pledge, positioning Europe as a leader in the transition to a climate-neutral economy.

item.title: CIR Statistics October 2026
item.description: The Central Bank of Cyprus released October 2026 statistics for the Central Information Register regarding bounced checks and issuers.

item.title: Opening remarks by the Governor of the Central Bank of Cyprus and member of the ECB Governing Council, ...
item.description: Governor Christodoulos Patsalides outlines the CBC's stance on monetary policy and economic outlook during a high-level briefing with international market participants.

item.title: Questions and answers on the Consumer Package
item.description: The EU's Digital Fairness Act will transform consumer protection into a directly applicable Regulation, banning dark patterns and addictive designs to harmonize rules across the Single Market.

item.title: Bringing the current MFF to a successful close: agreement on the final Annual Budget *
item.description: The EU reached a final agreement on the 2025 annual budget, marking a critical step in concluding the current Multiannual Financial Framework.

item.title: Commission strengthens consumer protection laws, making them fit for the digital age
item.description: The EU's new Digital Fairness Act and CPC Regulation revision aim to ban manipulative online tactics and grant the Commission direct fining powers over digital consumer breaches.

item.title: Remarks by Executive Vice-President Virkkunen and Commissioner McGrath on the Digital Fairness Act and a Consumer enforcement initiative
item.description: The EU has unveiled the Digital Fairness Act and updates to the CPC Regulation to combat digital manipulation and grant the Commission direct sanctioning powers.

item.title: Daily news - Nov 10, 2026
item.description: The EU-Ukraine Investment Conference in Warsaw aims to mobilize private investment for reconstruction, focusing on SME financing, energy, and regulatory alignment with the EU Single Market.

item.title: Central Bank of Cyprus balance sheet as at the end of August 2026
item.description: The Central Bank of Cyprus released its August 2026 balance sheet, providing essential data on the nation's monetary position and banking sector liquidity.

item.title: Foreign trade statistics: Provisional data for September 2026 and final data for August 2026
item.description: Cyprus trade activity surged in September 2026, with exports rising 89.1% and imports up 19.7%, despite a widening overall trade deficit for the year.

item.title: Commission issues €8 billion in its 10th syndicated transaction of 2026
item.description: The European Commission raised €8 billion through its 10th syndicated transaction of 2026, strengthening the EU-Bond curve liquidity for future sovereign and corporate pricing.

item.title: Commission approves €2 billion Belgian State aid to support offshore wind energy
item.description: The EU Commission approved a €2 billion Belgian offshore wind scheme, integrating Net Zero Industry Act criteria that mandate supply chain diversification for renewable energy projects.

item.title: Commission greenlights Estonia's final payment request for €190.6 million under NextGenerationEU
item.description: The European Commission has approved Estonia's final €190.6 million RRF payment following the successful completion of digital, health, and energy efficiency milestones.

item.title: Commission greenlights Luxembourg's final payment request for €59 million under NextGenerationEU
item.description: The European Commission has approved Luxembourg's final €59 million payment request under the Recovery and Resilience Facility, signaling the successful completion of its national recovery plan.

item.title: Statement on today's meeting in Abu Dhabi between the EU, France, Germany, Italy, United Kingdom, Ukraine, United States and NATO
item.description: Western allies and Ukraine met in Abu Dhabi to coordinate security guarantees and a post-war security architecture ahead of potential negotiations with Russia.

item.title: Updated Action Plan brings a total of 30 actions in one year under the Pact for the Mediterranean
item.description: The EU updated the Pact for the Mediterranean Action Plan, adding nine new initiatives to reach a total of 30 projects focusing on energy, skills, and regional integration.

item.title: Statement by President von der Leyen with Bulgarian Prime Minister Radev
item.description: The EU pledged €3.3 billion for Bulgarian defense and enhanced Black Sea maritime surveillance to counter Russian aggression, maritime disruptions, and disinformation campaigns.

item.title: Daily news - Nov 9, 2026
item.description: The European Commission has approved final RRF payments for Estonia and Luxembourg, signaling the successful completion of their recovery plans including significant AML and digital reforms.

item.title: Aggregate Cyprus banking sector data (non-performing loans data) - 31 July 2026
item.description: Cyprus's NPL ratio improved to 1.5% in July 2026, marking a positive shift in asset quality despite a slight decline in provision coverage.

item.title: Monetary Financial Institutions (MFIs) Deposits and Loans Statistics (27 Oct 2026)
item.description: Cyprus bank deposits reached €60.2 billion in September 2026, while total loans surged with a 14% annual growth rate, driven largely by non-financial corporations and domestic sectors.

item.title: More than 90 women participate in CBC's financial empowerment initiatives
item.description: The Central Bank of Cyprus successfully engaged over 90 women in financial empowerment workshops to improve national financial literacy and inclusion.

item.title: Dissolution and liquidation of the investment compartment M-RINCH1 of the AIF Monterock Investments AIF V.C.I.C. Plc
item.description: CySEC has announced the voluntary dissolution and liquidation of the M-RINCH1 investment compartment of Monterock Investments AIF V.C.I.C. Plc following total unit redemption.

item.title: Business Register (Data Update)
item.description: Cyprus's Statistical Service (CYSTAT) has released updated data for the Business Register of active legal entities, providing essential metrics for market analysis and compliance monitoring.

item.title: Statement by the Minister of Finance of the Republic of Cyprus during his participation in the Eurogroup meeting and the ECOFIN in Brussels
item.description: Cyprus Finance Minister Makis Keravnos calls for continued household energy support and "outside the box" EU investment in energy infrastructure to combat persistent inflationary pressures.

item.title: Tender regarding the ‘Provision of expert services for the assessment of applications for granting authorisation to CIFs, CCAUCI, UCITS Man Cos, AIFs, UCITS, AIFMs, AIFLNPs, CASPs, Crowdfunding Platforms, registration of RAIF and monitoring of substantial changes to regulated entities’
item.description: CySEC has issued a tender for external expert services to assist in the assessment and monitoring of various regulated financial entities and investment funds.

item.title: High-Level Platform meets in Moldova to strengthen digital connectivity between the EU and Central Asia
item.description: The EU and Central Asian nations convened in Moldova to advance digital connectivity and regulatory alignment under the Global Gateway initiative.

item.title: Statement by President von der Leyen with Romanian President Dan
item.description: The European Commission has confirmed Romania's full accession to the Schengen Area, ending land border controls effective January 1st, 2025.

item.title: EU emissions continue to fall as clean energy gains ground
item.description: EU greenhouse gas emissions dropped by 8% in 2023, driven by a significant shift toward renewable energy and reduced coal reliance across member states.

item.title: Daily news - Nov 8, 2026
item.description: The EU's 2026 climate reports show a 1.6% drop in GHG emissions and an 11% increase in ETS revenues, highlighting the ongoing decoupling of economic growth from carbon emissions.

item.title: EU seeks nominations for stakeholder group on tokenisation standards in finance
item.description: EU authorities invite financial industry stakeholders to join the European Tokenisation Standards Group (ETSG) to shape unified standards for tokenised financial ecosystems.

item.title: Statement by President von der Leyen following her call with President Zelenskyy and ahead of her visit to the Black Sea Region, in Romania and Bulgaria
item.description: EU President von der Leyen initiates a Black Sea diplomatic mission to address escalating security threats and restore freedom of navigation for food and energy infrastructure.

item.title: The Minister of Finance of the Republic of Cyprus travels to Brussels for the Eurogroup and ECOFIN meetings of 9 November 2026
item.description: Finance Minister Makis Keravnos attends Eurogroup/ECOFIN to lobby for tax flexibility on energy and discuss the digital euro, banking risks, and tobacco tax reforms.

item.title: The Minister of Finance travels to Brussels for the Eurogroup and ECOFIN Council meetings
item.description: Cyprus Finance Minister Makis Keravnos attends Eurogroup/ECOFIN meetings to lobby for tax relief on heating oil and discuss Eurozone banking stability and digital euro progress.

item.title: Speech: Press remarks by Executive Vice-President Fitto and Commissioner Tzitzikostas on the EU Sustainable Tourism Strategy
item.description: The European Commission has launched the EU Sustainable Tourism Strategy to coordinate growth, address labor shortages, and distribute economic benefits more widely across territories.

item.title: Speech: Remarks by High Representative/Vice-President Kallas and Commissioner Kos on the 2026 Enlargement Package
item.description: The EU's 2026 Enlargement Package prioritizes four frontrunners for accession while maintaining a standstill with Turkey and halting Georgia's progress due to democratic backsliding.

item.title: Statement following meeting on prosperity talks today
item.description: International stakeholders met to refine Ukraine's post-war reconstruction framework, emphasizing EU accession reforms as the primary driver for private investment and economic stability.

item.title: Questions and answers on the Education and Skills package
item.description: The European Commission has launched an Education and Skills package to combat declining basic skills, teacher shortages, and digital risks through AI literacy and structural reforms.

item.title: CBC Macroeconomic Forecasts for the Cyprus Economy
item.description: The Central Bank of Cyprus has released its 2026–2028 macroeconomic forecasts, providing critical projections for GDP growth, inflation, and employment to guide medium-term business planning.

item.title: Statement by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on the illegal visit of the Turkish Foreign Minister to the occupied areas
item.description: Cyprus condemns Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan's visit to occupied areas, labeling it a breach of international law and UN resolutions.
